reason: A browser UI plugin that adds configurable global keyboard shortcuts, shortcut recording and conflict detection, and bindings for common DeepSeek Harness interface actions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可配置的全局键盘快捷键、改键设置、冲突检测以及常用界面操作绑定。
summaries.en: Adds configurable global keyboard shortcuts, key remapping, conflict detection, and bindings for common DeepSeek Harness web interface actions.

capabilities: Registers a browser-level keydown listener for configured shortcuts
Dispatches keyboard shortcuts to supported web UI actions
Provides a settings page for recording, resetting, and conflict-checking key bindings
Prevents default browser handling for selected registered combinations
